newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell reports gains at all 3 businesses.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell reports gains at all 3 businesses.

text.p: Honeywell Inc, reporting third-quarter earnings per share rose 21 percent on a seven percent increase in sales, cited gains at all three of its businesses.

"Our third quarter results were driven by a solid performance in all three of our businesses -- home and building control, industrial control, and space and aviation control," said Chief Executive Michael Bonsignore.
The company's shares were up 1/4 to 65-1/2.
"Our focus on the bottom line continues to show excellent results, with a 50-basis-point improvement in operating margins and strong free cash flow," Bonsignore said.
In the home and building control segment, operating profit was $95.3 million, compared to $85.9 million a year earlier. Sales rose 11 percent to $852.3 million from $766.6 million.
In industrial control, operating profit was $51.6 million, compared with $47.6 million a year earlier. Sales rose to $512.6 million from $489.4 million.
In space and aviation control, operating profit was $39.9 million, up from $32.9 million in the third quarter of 1995. Sales were $401.1 million, up from $396.1 million.

"Orders for the quarter declined 10 percent as increases in commercial aviation orders were not enough to offset the strong order comparisons in military avionics in 1995, when that business received several large multi-year orders," the company said of its space and aviation business.
